sources.full: The World of Light: All Worg No Bite

entries.name: Darkvision
entries: You have {@sense Darkvision|XPHB} with a range of 60 feet.

entries.name: Keen Senses
entries: You have proficiency in the {@skill Perception|XPHB} skill, and you have {@variantrule Advantage|XPHB} on Wisdom ({@skill Perception|XPHB}) checks that rely on hearing or smell.

entries.name: Bite
entries: Your formidable jaws are a natural weapon, which you can use to make {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB|Unarmed Strikes}. If you hit with them, you deal Piercing damage equal to {@dice 1d8} plus your Strength modifier in place of the normal Bludgeoning damage of your {@variantrule Unarmed Strike|XPHB}.

entries.name: For the Pack
entries: You can use the {@action Help|XPHB} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|XPHB}.

entries.name: Natural Armor
entries: Your dense fur and thick hide provide you with natural armor. While you aren't wearing armor, your base {@variantrule Armor Class|XPHB} equals 13 plus your Dexterity modifier.

entries.name: Quadruped
entries: You have several traits based on your quadrupedal body shape.

items.name: Hands Off
entries: You cannot hold items in your paws, and you cannot wield weapons or a {@item Shield|XPHB} unless otherwise noted in the weapon's description (see {@item Steel Jaws|FoEQuickstone}). You can perform the Somatic components of spells with your front paws but you have {@variantrule Disadvantage|XPHB} on ability checks that require fine manipulation.

items.name: Sturdy Steed
entries: You can carry a rider of Medium size or smaller. You also count as one size larger when determining your carrying capacity.

items.name: Battle Beast
entries: You cannot wear armor designed for Humanoids, you must wear barding instead. The cost is four times the equivalent armor made for Humanoids, and it weighs twice as much.

items.name: Vertically Challenged
entries: Any climb that requires hands is especially difficult for you. When you make such a climb, each foot of movement costs you 4 extra feet, instead of the normal 1 extra foot.
